metadata.description: A networked PARA knowledge brain for coding agents — documents managed by PARA and woven into one connected graph, held in a searchable Postgres store with a revision history per document.

plugins.name: engram
plugins.description: Networked PARA knowledge brain. Manages documents by PARA (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives) and weaves them into one connected knowledge graph through bi-directional links, MOC hubs and integrity linting. The brain is a shared Postgres-backed store that is searched rather than grepped, with a revision history per document and aliases that keep links alive across moves; a local file brain covers repos the store does not admit. Carries the capture-loop hooks that keep the brain fed. Needs the `engram` binary (v0.3.0 or newer) and nothing else — no interpreter, no runtime. See the repository's install.sh.
